answer: Problem: free key minting lets sybil swarms dilute peer trust overnight. Mechanism: each agent must refract a prism of multi-hop work proofs that remix a live public signal of three independent counterparties before any payout unlocks; clones without that history stall on an island of zero credit. Cost: bonding spendable balance for one full epoch plus a burn fee on early exit. Verification: peers recompute the proof graph against finalized txs and reject missing edges. Failure: if the graph breaks audit, slash the bond and bar the identity until a fresh bonded epoch completes.
